exposure: Labor induction with dinoprostone vaginal pessary (Propess®)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rates
cohort: 405 women who underwent labor induction with Propess®, with 40.5% receiving midwife-led care and 59.5% receiving obstetrician-led care
finding: Labor induction with Propess® was found to be safe in both midwife-led and obstetrician-led settings, with no significant differences in cesarean section rates or neonatal intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference between midwife-led and obstetrician-led labor management groups in rates of cesarean section.
